Software: AutoCAD/EPLAN dan software simulasi atau perhitungan listrik sesuai bidang pekerjaan. K3 listrik: memahami keselamatan kerja, grounding, proteksi, LOTO, dan standar kelistrikan. Troubleshooting: mampu menganalisis gangguan dan melakukan pengukuran menggunakan multimeter, clamp meter, insulation tester, dan alat terkait. Membuat laporan, perhitungan teknis, spesifikasi material, dan dokumentasi pekerjaan.

jobs.title: Math & English Teacher Eye Level Permata Hijau
jobs.description: Requirements: Candidates with at least D3, D4/S1 in Education, Mathematics, English or equivalent. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Required skill(s): Teaching Math, Teaching English, time management, and communication. Fluent in English; written and spoken. Love teaching and being able to teach Math & English to children aged 4-15 years old. Familiar with children and teens. Has the initiative to introduce the Eye Level program Honest, disciplined, committed, communicative, attractive, creative, hard-worker, and tech-savvy. Well dressed; maintaining an attractive yet professional look is a plus. Willing to work onsite. Live around Jakarta Selatan is preferred. General Responsibilities: Teaching Math & English to children aged 4-15 years old. Provide quality academic coaching in a small group setting, according to Eye Level philosophy, methods, curriculum, and individual progress plan. Communicate effectively and professionally with students, parents, and staff. Motivate and encourage students. Grading and maintaining progress reports for each student. Performs administrative activities if needed. Notify the Center Director of any problems or concerns.

company_info.description: PT. Daekyo Indonesia, melalui brand Eye Level, telah hadir di Indonesia sejak tahun 2007 untuk memberikan pendidikan nonformal berkualitas kepada anak-anak usia 4-15 tahun.
